metadata.title: The Neon Dragon of Pixel Harbour
metadata.subtitle: A pocket gamebook
metadata.author: Original story
metadata.description: ORIGINAL CONTENT. Not taken or adapted from any published gamebook. A short choose-your-path adventure set in a pixel-art version of Hong Kong.

energy.name: Energy
energy.description: If it runs out, it's game over!

power.name: Pixel Power
power.description: Added to your dice roll in a duel. Rolled at the start: 1 die + 6.

luck.name: Luck
luck.description: Roll this or less on two dice to pass a luck test. Each test uses 1. Rolled at the start: 1 die + 6.

secret_route.description: Found the pearl in the Gremlin Vault

token.name: Arcade Token
token.description: Shiny brass tokens. Some things in Pixel Harbour cost one or two.

egg_tart.name: Egg Tart
egg_tart.description: Warm, wobbly and delicious. Eat it for +4 Energy, or maybe someone else is hungry...

lantern.name: Rabbit Lantern
lantern.description: A glowing paper rabbit lantern. Light shows hidden things.

brass_key.name: Brass Key
brass_key.description: A tiny key shaped like a dragon's claw. The tag says VAULT.

whistle.name: Silver Whistle
whistle.description: One note makes any machine dance.

pearl.name: Pearl of Light
pearl.description: Warm as a tiny sun. The Neon Dragon needs it back!

intro.title: Insert Coin
text: Rain drums on the windows of the Golden Joystick, the tiniest arcade in Mong Kok. Neon signs buzz outside, painting the puddles pink and blue.

You, {{name}}, have three arcade tokens left in your pocket, and there's one machine you have never seen before. It sits in the back corner, humming softly. On its screen, a dragon made of glowing lights is curled around the words NEON DRAGON. Underneath, letters flash: THE PEARL IS LOST. PLAYER ONE, PLEASE HELP.
Funny. You're sure it wasn't there yesterday.

illustration.alt: A glowing arcade machine in a rainy Mong Kok arcade

choices.label: Drop a token into the slot
Ask Auntie Lam about the strange machine

auntie.title: Auntie Lam
text: Auntie Lam runs the arcade. She is small and quick and never stops snacking. Today she is guarding a box of warm egg tarts behind the counter.

"That old thing?" she says, squinting. "It only switches on when someone brave walks in. Last time was... hmm, 1986?" She pushes an egg tart into your hand. "Take this. Heroes need snacks. And if you meet a robot, remember: everybody gets grumpy when they're hungry."

choices.label: Drop a token into the Neon Dragon machine

portal.title: Pixel Harbour
text: The token clinks. The screen flares so brightly you have to shut your eyes, and the floor drops away like the first second of a rollercoaster.

When you open your eyes, you're standing on a pier made of chunky square pixels. In front of you is Hong Kong... but not quite. The skyscrapers are built from glowing blocks, the harbour sparkles in eight colours, and the moon is a perfect pixel circle.

A plump orange cat with a dumpling-shaped face sits beside you. "Finally! Player One!" it says. "I'm Siu Mai. The Neon Dragon keeps the lights of Pixel Harbour shining with her Pearl of Light, but the Glitch Gremlins stole it! If the pearl isn't back by midnight, every light here goes out. For good."
Siu Mai points two ways with its tail: towards a noisy night market, and towards the ferry pier.

illustration.alt: A pixel-art harbour skyline at night with an orange cat

market.title: Night Market
text: Paper lanterns sway above a street packed with stalls. A pixel fish-ball seller flips sizzling snacks, and a robot grandma sells socks that change colour every few seconds.

At one stall, rows of glowing rabbit lanterns bob on strings. A sign says: ONE TOKEN. NEVER RUNS OUT. Next to it is a claw machine stuffed with prizes, and right at the bottom something small and brass glints.
At the end of the street, the Peak Tram rattles, ready to climb the hill.

illustration.alt: A pixel night market with lanterns

choices.label: Ride the Peak Tram up the hill
This is too spooky. Find a way home

lantern_stall.title: The Lantern Seller
text: The lantern seller is a tall, gentle crane wearing reading glasses. She picks out the brightest rabbit lantern of all and hands it to you. Its paper ears glow warm and gold.
"Light shows the hidden things," she says. "Keep it close in dark places."

choices.label: Ride the Peak Tram up the hill

claw.title: The Claw Machine
text: You drop in a token. Music plays. The claw whirrs down... down... down... towards the tiny brass glint.
This one is all about luck!

test.label: TEST YOUR LUCK
test.prompt: Roll two dice. If the total is equal to or less than your LUCK, the claw grabs the prize. (Each try uses up 1 LUCK.)

claw_win.title: Got It!
text: The claw closes with a CLUNK and lifts out a little brass key shaped like a dragon's claw. A paper tag hangs from it: VAULT. KEEP AWAY FROM GREMLINS.
The lantern seller whistles. "Lucky! Nobody has won that in a hundred years."

choices.label: Ride the Peak Tram up the hill

claw_lose.title: So Close!
text: The claw grabs a rubber duck, wobbles, and drops it. Then it slowly drops nothing at all, as if it's laughing at you.
Never mind. It's only a game. Probably.

pier.title: Ferry Pier
text: A green-and-white ferry bobs at the pier, its paddle wheels made of spinning pixels. The captain is a large, sleepy toad in a captain's hat.
"Crossing to Lighthouse Island costs two tokens," he croaks. "No tokens, no boat. Them's the rules."
Out on the dark water, the lighthouse blinks: on... off... on. It looks like it's trying to tell you something.

illustration.alt: A pixel ferry at a pier with a lighthouse in the distance

choices.label: Pay two tokens and climb aboard
Sneak aboard while the captain yawns

sneak.title: Ribbit!
text: You tiptoe up the gangplank... and step right on the captain's foot.
"RIBBIT!" he bellows. He scoops you up and plops you back on the pier with a soggy SPLOSH. You're dripping wet and a little embarrassed.

choices.label: Squelch back to the night market

ferry.title: Across the Harbour
text: The ferry chugs across the sparkling harbour. Pixel fish leap alongside, and the city lights twinkle on the waves, though some of them flicker and go dark as you watch.

Halfway across, three small purple creatures pop out of the water, giggling. Glitch Gremlins! They tug at the ropes and blow raspberries. The captain flicks out his long tongue (THWIP!) and the gremlins tumble back into the waves.
"Pests," he grumbles. "They carried a shiny pearl up to the Sky Tower on the Peak. Saw them myself."

lighthouse.title: Lighthouse Island
text: Lighthouse Island is tiny: rocks, a bench and a tall stripy lighthouse. The keeper is an old pixel tortoise who has been waiting for company for a very, very long time.

She pours you a cup of hot lemon tea, then presses something cold and shiny into your hand. "The Silver Whistle. One note makes any machine dance, whether it wants to or not." She chuckles. "Very useful around robots."
From the top of the lighthouse you can see the Peak, with the Sky Tower glowing angrily on top. A cable car swings down to fetch you.

choices.label: Ride the cable car to the Peak

tram.title: The Peak Tram
text: The little red tram clanks and begins to climb. The hill is so steep that the buildings outside seem to lean sideways.
Halfway up, the tram rattles into a long tunnel, and every light goes out. The tram stops with a jolt. Somewhere in the dark, something giggles.

illustration.alt: A dark tunnel with a small tram

choices.label: Feel your way through the dark

tunnel_dark.title: Bonk!
text: You climb out and shuffle forward with your hands stretched out. BONK! A wall. BONK! Another wall. A gremlin stamps on your toe and runs away cackling.
By the time you find the end of the tunnel you're bruised and grumpy, but you've reached the top of the Peak.

tunnel_lit.title: Hidden Door
text: Golden light spills from your lantern. The giggling stops (gremlins hate light!) and you spot something the dark was hiding: a small round door in the tunnel wall, painted with a dragon's claw.
Underneath, someone has scratched: GREMLIN VAULT. KEEP OUT. (THIS MEANS YOU.)

choices.label: Unlock the door with the brass key
Leave the door and walk up to the Peak

door_locked.title: Locked
text: The handle won't budge. The keyhole is shaped like a tiny claw. Somewhere in Pixel Harbour there must be a key that fits...

choices.label: Walk on up to the Peak
Ride the tram back down to the market

vault.title: The Gremlin Vault
text: The key turns with a satisfying click. Inside is a cosy little room piled high with everything the gremlins have ever stolen: odd socks, TV remotes, a thousand lost umbrellas... and, on a velvet cushion, a pearl as big as an orange, glowing with soft white light.
The Pearl of Light! You scoop it up. It feels warm, like holding a tiny sun. The gremlins were so busy guarding the Sky Tower that they forgot to guard their own vault.

choices.label: Race up to the Neon Dragon

peak_top.title: The Peak
text: The top of the Peak is windy and wild. Far below, Pixel Harbour twinkles, but whole streets have already gone dark. The Sky Tower looms above you, and the Neon Dragon is coiled weakly around it, her lights dim and flickering.
Blocking the tower door stands BOLT-BOT, the gremlins' guard: a rusty robot as tall as a bus, with a saucepan for a head. "HALT," it booms. "NO. PLAYERS. ALLOWED."
Its tummy makes a long, sad rumble.

illustration.alt: A big rusty robot guarding a tower door

bot_dance.title: Robot Boogie
text: You blow one bright silver note. Bolt-Bot freezes. Then its feet start tapping. Its arms start swinging. In seconds it is doing the robot (badly) and it boogies right out of the doorway and away down the hill.
"I. CANNOT. STOP," it wails happily.

bot_snack.title: Snack Attack
text: Bolt-Bot sniffs. Its saucepan head tilts. Then it gobbles the egg tart in one bite, and its eyes turn into two pink hearts.
"DELICIOUS," it says. "NOBODY. EVER. FEEDS. BOLT-BOT." It steps aside and gives you a creaky thumbs-up. Auntie Lam was right!

bot_battle.title: Duel!
text: You raise your fists. Bolt-Bot raises its huge rubber-glove fists.
"BEEP BOOP. PREPARE. FOR. BOPPING."

combat.intro: Each round, you and Bolt-Bot both roll two dice and add your attack. Higher total lands a bop (the loser loses 2). Knock Bolt-Bot down to 0 to win!

bot_beaten.title: Clang!
text: With one last bop, Bolt-Bot topples over with a mighty CLANG, its saucepan head spinning like a top.
"OKAY. OKAY. YOU. WIN," it says, and sits down for a little rest. The tower door swings open.

tower_top.title: The Gremlin King
text: At the very top of the tower, in a room full of tangled wires and flashing screens, sits the Gremlin King. He is the size of a cat, wears a bottle-cap crown, and is juggling the Pearl of Light from hand to hand.

"Ooh, a Player!" he squeaks. "I suppose you want my lovely shiny pearl? Well, you can't have it. Unless..." He grins a wide, pointy grin. "Unless you can answer my riddle! Get it wrong and I keep the pearl forever, and midnight turns your little city dark!"
A clock on the wall ticks towards twelve.

illustration.alt: A small purple gremlin king with a bottle-cap crown holding a glowing pearl

grab.title: Grab It!
text: You lunge for the pearl just as the Gremlin King tosses it into the air...

test.label: TEST YOUR LUCK
test.prompt: Roll two dice. Equal to or under your LUCK and you snatch it! (Uses up 1 LUCK.)

grab_win.title: Snatched!
text: Your fingers close around the warm, glowing pearl. "Hey! No fair!" squeals the Gremlin King, but you're already racing up the stairs to the roof.

grab_fail.title: Fizz!
text: The Gremlin King hops aside and you crash into a pile of wires. Sparks fizz. Ouch!
"Tsk, tsk," he says, wagging a finger. "No grabbing. Riddle time!"

riddle.title: The Riddle
text: The Gremlin King clears his throat.
"I have hands, but I cannot clap. I have a face, but I cannot smile. I run all day, but I never leave the wall. What am I?"
Behind him, the clock ticks loudly. Tick. Tock. Tick...

riddle_right.title: Correct!
text: The Gremlin King's mouth falls open. "How did you... nobody ever... oh, FINE."
He sulks and tosses you the pearl. "Rules are rules, even for gremlins."

dragon_summit.title: The Neon Dragon
text: You burst out onto the tower roof. The wind howls. The Neon Dragon lifts her great head. She is enormous, made of a million tiny lights, but almost all of them have gone dim.
"Player One," she whispers, in a voice like distant thunder. "Do you have it?"
Below you, the clock begins to chime midnight.

illustration.alt: A huge dragon made of dim lights coiled around a tower

choices.label: Hold up the Pearl of Light

victory.title: Lights On!
text: The pearl leaps from your hands and spins into the dragon's chest. FWOOOSH! Light races through her body (red, gold, green, blue) and bursts out across the city. Every building, every boat and every lantern blazes back to life.
Fireworks bloom over the harbour, spelling out a word in giant pixel letters: {{name}}!
The dragon bows her head. "Thank you, hero." Siu Mai purrs so loudly the whole roof vibrates.
Then, with a blink, you're back in the Golden Joystick. The machine's screen shows a brand-new HIGH SCORE with your name next to it. Auntie Lam winks and hands you another egg tart.

illustration.alt: Fireworks over a brightly lit pixel harbour

riddle_wrong.title: Lights Out
text: "WRONG!" cackles the Gremlin King. BONG... BONG... BONG... The clock strikes midnight. One by one, the lights of Pixel Harbour blink out, until only the moon is left.
Everything goes black, and then you're back in the Golden Joystick, standing in front of the machine. The screen says: GAME OVER. INSERT TOKEN TO TRY AGAIN.
Maybe next time, listen to the clock...

zapped.title: Bopped!
text: BOP! Bolt-Bot's giant rubber fist sends you spinning... and spinning... and you land on your bottom on the floor of the Golden Joystick.
The machine flashes: GAME OVER. BOLT-BOT WINS THIS ROUND.
Next time, maybe try a different idea. Even robots have soft spots.

out_of_energy.title: Out of Energy
text: Your pixels go fuzzy... then fizzy... then fade away completely.
You blink and find yourself sitting on a stool in the Golden Joystick, completely worn out. Rest up, have a snack, and try again!

go_home.title: Home Safe
text: You decide that's enough adventure for one night. Siu Mai sighs, but shows you a glowing exit door.
You step through and you're back in the arcade, warm and dry. The Neon Dragon machine flickers... then switches off.
Somewhere, a pixel city is getting darker. Maybe tomorrow you'll feel braver?
